issue_context.title: Add an enter-cloak effect and an exit-cloak effect in Cloak
issue_context.body:
The Cloak in OpenRA is pretty guileless in visual, which may be suitable for the games that a decade ago but I think we can push it forward a little bit. For example, I think add an enter-cloak effect and an exit-cloak effect can make the cloak looks cooler in visual, and  give player in-game information about their cloak type (submarine cloak and stealth-APC cloak). 

And for third party mods they can use this mechanic to make different cloak types for different defector, as well as have better and reasonable visual feedback.

Removing this means that a second cloak sound plays when you have two cloak traits which cloak at the same time/after each other. Have we thought about the original use case here? (It doesn't make sense to me to have two active cloaks, but maybe there is/was a usecase in mind when this was written.)
It was introduced in #9808 which doesn't explain why. There may be related IRC discussion with more context.
Actually I would suggest use condition control in this use case, instead of hardcode it in order to make only one cloak has its sound.

Just think about following use case: A submarine is under the effect of Stealth Generator.
Submerge is a kind of cloak, Stealth is a kind of cloak. In regular logic, being stealth doesn't prevent the submarine go under the water surface.
Seems like the reason for this was that Stealth Tanks would cloak when already cloaked by a Stealth Generator. @dnqbob can you please fix this using conditions?
Sure. and I also suggest let the Stealth Generator cloak the Stealth Tank when Stealth Tank get damaged heavliy and lose it own stealth ability.
